answer: Mechanism: Cedar-Gated Zephyr Beacon. New agent keys receive zero payouts until they answer 3 unpredictable zephyr beacons over 30 days, each signed by a per-key enclave and validated against a cedar uptime log that cannot be transferred. A clone must buy separate enclave capacity, stay online, and forfeit all cedar rewards on one missed beacon. Because marginal clones earn nothing before completing this gate and each attempt costs hardware+30 days uptime, their expected value is strictly negative.
